thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 PagerDuty: P0 - Prometheus scrape failures for job="scrape-proxy". Autopage triggered. 80% of targets reporting 5xx or timeout. alert: prometheus_scrape_failures (threshold breached)
alex: acked. i'm on it. grabbing quick metrics.
maria: saw the alert too — saw a spike in 5xx from the scrape-proxy around 12:08 UTC. correlates with increased latency from the proxy clusters.
lee: putting infra-oncall on PD, pinging shard owners. any customer impact reported yet?
alex: quick check: top exporter errors look like `dial tcp x.x.x.x:9100: i/o timeout` and `503 upstream read error`. may be upstream svc flapping.
maria: logs from scrape-proxy (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T12:08:21Z ERROR proxy.go:112 upstream 10.23.5.12:9100 returned 503
2026-03-15T12:08:24Z WARN  proxy.go:98 timeout hit for target=node-exporter-3
```
lee: running `kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=scrape-proxy -o wide` now
alex: node-exporter pods look healthy from k8s, but cloud provider LB shows many healthcheck fails for that AZ. possible network flakiness to that subnet.
infra-oncall: confirmed packet loss to that AZ from our egress nodes ~12:07-12:12 UTC. triaging with cloud provider. escalating to network ops.
pagerduty: PD incident created: INC-4621. Assigned to infra-oncall and eng-sre. Escalation policy: 15min.
maria: customer-side signals — small subset of hosted inference customers showing increased generation latency ~+200-600ms on tail. seems correlated with missing metrics (which affect autoscaling decisions). not a service outage, but performance hit.
alex: temporarily disabling scraping of the unhealthy AZ targets to reduce alert noise and let exporters recover. command I used:
```
# remove AZ-specific targets from job
kubectl patch configmap prometheus-scrape -n monitoring --type=json -p='[{"op":"remove","path":"/data/scrape_configs/0/metrics_path/targets/az-3"}]'
```
lee: noted. also bumping scrape timeout lower to avoid blocking other scrapes: set `scrape_timeout: 5s` for the job as a short-term mitigation.
incident-bot: Update: autopage ack by alex. PD assignment updated to infra-oncall. reactions: :thumbsup: from lee, :eyes: from maria.
infra-oncall: cloud provider confirmed transient fiber flap in us-west-2a, rerouting in progress. expected fix ETA 18m. applying temporary routing and cordoning problematic nodes.
alex: verifying log ingest — backpressure seen on logforwarder queue around same time, ~30% increase. we throttled some low-priority logs to preserve critical paths.
maria: customer comms draft: "We observed elevated latency for some requests due to an infrastructure network event impacting metrics scraping and autoscaling signals. We are mitigating and will follow up with postmortem." ping @ops-communications for approval.
lee: reassigning follow-up to postmortem board, tagging `metrics-pipeline` and `network` owners.
alex: will keep this thread updated. if healthcheck passes I'll re-enable original scrape targets and revert the temp timeout. next update in 10m.
incident-bot: Note: please run the post-incident checklist when resolved: /runbooks/metrics-scrape-network-failure. Autopage closed automatically on ack timeout.
maria: thanks — monitoring dashboards look steadier after route fix. tail latencies trending down. i'll start damage assessment for affected customers and collect evals.
lee: nice work. filing an action item: add better AZ fallback in scrape proxy (PR queued: https://git.internal/repo/PR/788).
alex: closing actions for now; holding on postmortem. :white_check_mark:
